hypothesis.statement: Previous-session directional options flow, corroborated by Hidden Angles, research and technical analysis, selects overnight stock positions whose average net close-to-next-open sleeve return is positive and exceeds an exposure-matched SPY comparator on the same eligible nights because persistent information-driven repricing continues overnight.
hypothesis.economic_reason: Unproven proposed mechanism: persistent information-driven repricing continues overnight.
hypothesis.falsifier: Non-positive average net sleeve return or non-positive average paired excess versus the predeclared exposure-matched comparator; insufficient complete evidence is inconclusive.

comparator.description: Same eligible overnight opportunities and exposure budget, with cash, missed, failed and unknown observations retained.
comparator.selection_reason: Proposed comparison tests incremental net sleeve economics under equal information/time/exposure/cost conventions.
